stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples. GSE294565 holds only TA muscle after PBS or BaCl2 chemical injury (young/old, vehicle/BI01). The paper's exercise-like stimulus, 28-d synergist-ablation mechanical overload of plantaris (S2.6.p1, S4.3.p1), was not sequenced (FIG8-9 are histology/mass only). Injury-induced regeneration is not exercise, and BI01 vs vehicle is a drug effect, so no group comparison here answers how exercise affects gene expression.
